name: bregsurv
description: Transfer learning for survival analysis (Cox PH & nested case-control) via Bregman divergence. Local computation through your R installation.
long_description:
BregSurv is a Bregman-divergence-based transfer learning framework for survival analysis. It enables borrowing of external study information while accommodating population heterogeneity. Three external-data modes are supported: individual-level (full external data), KL divergence (external coefficients only), and Mahalanobis distance (external coefficients + curvature). High-dimensional ridge/elastic-net regularization and cross-validation are supported across full-cohort Cox PH and 1:m nested case-control designs.

This MCP extension exposes 34 tools plus a guided wizard prompt (/bregsurv-start) for selecting the right model. Computation runs entirely on your local machine via your installed R; patient-level data never leaves the machine. Prerequisites (you must install these first): R ≥ 4.0 (https://cran.r-project.org/) and the BregSurv R package (in R: install.packages('BregSurv')). Python is NOT required — Claude Desktop's bundled uv runtime handles that automatically.

rscript_path.title: Rscript executable
rscript_path.description: Full path to the Rscript executable on your machine. Prerequisites: (1) R ≥ 4.0 from https://cran.r-project.org/, and (2) the BregSurv R package — in R, run install.packages('BregSurv'). Typical Rscript locations — Windows: C:\Program Files\R\R-4.x.x\bin\Rscript.exe; macOS: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/Rscript or /usr/local/bin/Rscript; Linux: /usr/bin/Rscript.
